title: An option that has a default is not given with --arg: the refusal says it is written in the machine

shown: 'index-range': --arg names no step option the machine leaves to the run
what it leaves to the run: it leaves none
hint: an option a step has a default for, or may go without, is written in the machine: [(<input>, index-range=<value>) -> <step> -> <output>]
